notes: Lofty Denial, printed: 'Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1}.' Any spell may be the target, not only a creature spell (a sorcery here): seat 0 casts the sorcery Crash Through ({R}; 'Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn. Draw a card.') and has nothing left, seat 1 counters it with Lofty Denial. Seat 0 cannot pay {1}: the sorcery is countered, so seat 0 draws nothing (its hand stays 0) and Crash Through is in the graveyard.
